Once you've trained enough, you can participate in numerous cross-country races, and each Sunday you can win a cup! Show your rivals that by living with horses a dream can come true!

miburiteburi.title: Miburi & Teburi
miburiteburi.description: The journey begins! Explore the various islands and find the treasure Masamune!

voicethelaplusbellevoix.title: Voice, The - La Plus Belle Voix
voicethelaplusbellevoix.description: A video game adaptation of the French version of The Voice.

gesundheitscoachder.title: Gesundheitscoach, Der
gesundheitscoachder.description: Der Gesundheitscoach is a health and fitness game released in Europe for the Nintendo Wii.

billysbootcampwiideenjoydiet.title: Billy's Boot Camp - Wii de Enjoy Diet!
billysbootcampwiideenjoydiet.description: Billy's Boot Camp: Wii de Enjoy Diet! (ビリーズブートキャンプ Wiiでエンジョイダイエット!) is a fitness game based on the military fitness method advocated by Billy Wayne Blanks in the United States. Levels and popular track inclusions allow players to experience the game's completely different but equally interesting fun! The game gives players a more efficient fitness slimming effect, displaying the current calorie consumption after each practice. Players can also collect various slimming actions in the form of "action cards".

thorgodofthunder.title: Thor - God of Thunder
thorgodofthunder.description:
Thor: God of Thunder is an action-adventure game developed by Liquid Entertainment and published by Sega in 2011. It serves as a tie-in to the Thor film from the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Players control Thor as he wields Mjolnir to battle enemies across the Nine Realms, facing iconic foes such as Surtur and Ulik while protecting Asgard from destruction.

The gameplay features melee combat, elemental powers, and environmental puzzles, with some differences across platforms. The console versions (PlayStation 3, Xbox 360) emphasise 3D action, while the Nintendo 3DS and Wii versions include more stylised and simplified gameplay.

kohlanta.title: Koh-Lanta
kohlanta.description: Adaptation of the French TV show in which players undertake various challenges in order to be the last person remaining on a desert island.

babyandme.title: Baby and Me
babyandme.description: The new hit game where you play as 6 year old girl raising her own child. Because a 6 year old would have her own child, right?

jigsawpuzzlekyounowanko.title: Jigsaw Puzzle - Kyou no Wanko
jigsawpuzzlekyounowanko.description: Bringing the popular Jigsaw Puzzle series over from the DS, the first Wii installment features puzzles based around the Kyou no Wanko segment that airs early morning on Fuji Television.

vozvol3la.title: Voz Vol. 3, La
vozvol3la.description: La Voz Vol. 3 is a karaoke game based on the Spanish television singing competition of the same name. Sing through 30 songs in Spanish and English, with modes that recreate the show's various stages including blind auditions and battles. Play solo in career modes, compete against friends in multiplayer modes like duels and teams, or perform in the exclusive "The Show" mode that faithfully recreates the television program's format. The game includes official music videos and supports optional microphone controllers for an authentic performance experience.

vozlaquierotuvoz.title: Voz, La - Quiero tu Voz
vozlaquierotuvoz.description: Grab the mic and follow each beat and musical note, while the score counter multiplies with each matched melody.

isometrickarateexercisewiidekotsubanfitn.title: Isometric & Karate Exercise - Wii de Kotsuban Fitness

mindbodysoulnutritionmatters.title: Mind. Body. Soul. - Nutrition Matters
mindbodysoulnutritionmatters.description: Discover just how healthy you really are? Nutrition Matters is perfect if you're looking for a fun way to maintain a healthy balance between diet and exercise in the comfort of your living room. In fact, you can combine nutrition matters with your fitness game of choice for all round well-being. Use your Wii as your personal nutrition monitor to easily track your calories and measure them against daily activities in order to reach your personal fitness goals.

rtlwintersports2008theultimatechallenge.title: RTL Winter Sports 2008 - The Ultimate Challenge
rtlwintersports2008theultimatechallenge.description: Winter Sports: The Ultimate Challenge is an arcade-oriented 3D simulation of the most popular winter sports. It features 15 different disciplines in 9 different sports like skiing, bobsleigh, speedskating, ski jumping, figure skating and curling. In campaign mode you can try to master all of the 42 challenges to unlock more levels. The competition mode offers an Olympic event with opening and medal ceremony. The realism is enhanced through commentators, TV cameras, mascots and background sound. There are multiplayer modes for up to four players.

jawamammothtohimitsunoishi.title: Jawa - Mammoth to Himitsu no Ishi
jawamammothtohimitsunoishi.description: This rythm-based game let's you fight against more than 270 dinosaurs by shaking the Wii remote following the instructions on screen. Takes place in Stone Age and you control a caveman.

meinneueslebenabenteuerauftropicana.title: Mein neues Leben - Abenteuer auf Tropicana

tokyofriendparkiiketteibanminnadechousen.title: Tokyo Friend Park II - Ketteiban - Minna de Chousen! Taikan Attraction!
tokyofriendparkiiketteibanminnadechousen.description: In Tokyo Friend Park II Ketteiban: Minna de Chousen! Taikan Attraction, the player will be transformed into a special guest of the show and challenge the various gravitational activities in the show.

ontdekkerenhetmysterievandediamantenscar.title: Ontdekker en het Mysterie van de Diamanten Scarabee, De
ontdekkerenhetmysterievandediamantenscar.description: De Ontdekker en het mysterie van de Diamanten Scarabee you play the role of Ben the Archaeologist who is searching for the Temple of the Diamond Scarab. Once he is in the temple he meets Tiri, an enchanting Egyptian princess. Going through a maze of underground passages they look for ancient Egyptian treasures and confront various challenges. The Guardian leads them step by step to the exit. The game is played on a Balance Board, a standard Wii accessory. With this you can move through the maze, find treasures and enter challenging situations. Since this is the first game in the world developed jointly for visually impaired, blind and fully sighted children, the game can be played in Dutch and in English.

planetrescuewildlifevet.title: Planet Rescue - Wildlife Vet
planetrescuewildlifevet.description:
Planet Rescue is a range of games focusing on environment issues. While children play, they also learn about endangered animals, pollution, and what can be done to help improve our behaviours. In Planet Rescue: Wildlife Vet, you have a great opportunity to join the most prestigious NGO vet clinic in the world. Choose the vet you want to be, male or female, pass the test period and start your permanent new job position in this environmental organisation. Besides managing your own clinic, you will tour the world to rescue, heal and take care of wild animals. Most of them are endangered species like the Sea Turtle, Florida Panther, Giraffe or the China Panda Bear for instance.

More than 30 missions around the world, to heal endangered exotic animals, or to treat the animals directly in the clinic.
Depending on the weather and the place, choose the right outfits to perform the treatment in the best conditions.
Use the Wii Remote to perform realistic actions: rescue, diagnose and treat a variety of different species - adult and baby animals such as Florida Panther, Giraffe, China Panda Bear, Zebra, Kangaroos, India Elephant...
Take care of your own pet: a cute baby tiger! Feed and clean it, play with it, and make sure it stays healthy!
